card.name: Sentence-start verbs telling reader to consult
card.fires_on: The first word of an instruction sentence such as Refer, Ask or Tell, or words just before a person to be told or consulted (discuss with the patient). Also seen after a number or name in a list.

modes.label: Referral commands
modes.description: Sentence-opening verbs like Refer, Ask or Tell that direct the reader to a doctor, nurse or table.

modes.label: Discuss with the patient
modes.description: Words inside phrases like discuss ... with the patient and caregiver, where a counseling object follows.
modes.example: Discuss the availability of naloxone for the emergency treatment of opioid overdose with<< the>> patient and caregiver and assess the potential need

modes.label: Spacing before numbers
modes.description: A space or title just before a number or credential in a descriptive or byline sentence.

card.writes: It suppresses advice and counseling words, so the model is less likely to continue with advice or counsel wording.
card.plain: It fires on words that tell someone to ask, refer or discuss with a doctor or patient, and holds back the word advice.
